title: Settings
subtitle: Switch profiles or update how math practice works for each learner.
unsavedChangesBody: Do you want to save your changes before leaving Settings?
choosePracticeSettingsHint: These options apply to this practice session. You can also save them to the current profile.
learningPlanHelp: Turn operations on or off. For addition and subtraction, use one slider per number (each side is from 1 up to that maximum).
saveHint: Saves your profile and math options on this device
addNameHint: Add a profile name and your name so we can cheer you on.
randomizeOrderHint: When on, either number may appear first (for example 8 × 5 as well as 5 × 8).
multiplicationPoolHint: Each question uses one factor from these numbers. Pick which pool the second factor uses below.
selectedOnlyHint: Second number is also one of your selected numbers.
pool1to10Hint: Second number can be any whole number from 1 to 10.
pool1to20Hint: Second number can be any whole number from 1 to 20.
divisorsHint: Only these divisors appear after the division sign.
remaindersHint: When on, questions may ask for quotient and remainder (e.g. 17 ÷ 5 = 3 R 2).
squareHelpFractions: Pick the largest integer base used in each question (from 1 up to your limit).
squareHelpIntegers: Integer questions like 7² = ?. The base is chosen from 1 up to the limit you pick.
squareRootHelpFractions: The answer (the root) is from 1 up to the limit you pick, or a simple fraction when fractions are on.
squareRootHelpIntegers: Integer perfect squares like √81 = ?. The answer is from 1 up to the limit you pick.
orderOfOpsHelp: Uses the form a + b × c = ? (multiply before you add), with optional squares and square roots. Each number is based on the limit you pick.
equivalentExpressionsDesc: Choose expressions that have the same value or algebraic meaning.
subtractSeconds: Subtract {{n}} seconds on a wrong answer
answerChoicesHint: Maximum answer choices shown per question (some types have fewer).
keyboardAnswersHint: Type numeric answers when a question allows it.
keyboardMcOnlyHint: Odd/even, comparisons, shapes, clocks, and similar questions still use answer choices.
geometryChoicesHint: Geometry formula and π questions still use answer choices.
confirmAnswerHint: Pick an option, then tap Confirm before the answer is counted. When off, your choice counts as soon as you tap it.
timerEnabled: {{seconds}} seconds for each question. When time runs out, an answer is chosen for you.
timerOff: Timer is off. Turn it on to set how long each question can take (default {{default}} seconds when enabled).
shapeRecognitionDesc: Identify shapes and continue shape patterns.
clockDesc: Read analog clocks and elapsed time.
fractionRecognitionDesc: Shaded parts of a shape as fractions.
numberSenseDesc: Build early number sense with numbers and groups of objects.
expressionCompareHint: Uses the enabled addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division operations.
systemsEquationsDesc: Turn this on to practice solving for x and y using two equations.
logarithmDesc: Log rules and finding log values (bases 2, 3, 5, 10, and ln).
advancedEquationsDesc: Solve multi-step linear and factorable quadratic equations.
limitsDesc: Evaluate introductory polynomial and rational limits.

validation.chooseOperation: Choose at least one topic to practice.
validation.logSubtypes: Logarithms: turn on at least one question type.
validation.advancedEquationSubtypes: Linear & quadratic equations: turn on at least one question type.
validation.limitSubtypes: Limits: turn on at least one question type.
validation.operationStyle: {{operation}}: turn on at least one of standard calculation, missing number, fractions, or word problems.
validation.eqMulFactors: Equations with x (multiplication): set multiplication factors first.
validation.eqDivRange: Equations with x (division): fix the answer range under Division.
validation.eqDivDivisors: Equations with x (division): pick at least one divisor under Division.
validation.addRange1: Addition/Subtraction: the first number range is not valid.
validation.addRange2: Addition/Subtraction: the second number range is not valid.
validation.mulFactors: Multiplication: pick at least one number from 1 to 10 to multiply with.
validation.divRange: Division: the answer range is not valid.
validation.divDivisors: Division: pick at least one number from 1 to 10 to divide by.
validation.divRemainders: Division remainders: pick at least one divisor of 2 or more (remainder needs divisor ≥ 2).
validation.rounding: Rounding: choose at least one nearest option.
validation.geometryShapes: Geometry: pick at least one shape.
validation.geometryQuestions: Geometry: turn on formula or calculate questions.
validation.geometryMeasure: Geometry: turn on perimeter, area, or volume.
validation.equivalentExpressions: Equivalent expressions: turn on at least one question type.
validation.trigModes: Trigonometry: turn on pick formula or name sides.
validation.trigRatios: Trigonometry: pick at least one ratio for formula questions.
validation.questionCount: Pick a supported number of questions (5, 10, 15, or 20).
validation.answerChoices: Pick 2, 3, 4, or 6 answer choices (maximum shown per question).
validation.timer: Timer: set how many seconds to allow for each question.
validation.addCap: Addition: no answers fit within your maximum answer. Try a higher answer limit or smaller number ranges.
validation.unsupportedCap: The saved maximum answer setting is not supported.
